The '''White Maw Massacre''' was a battle between the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and the [[Eternal Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="FF" /> in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Year" /> The White Maw captured the [[Firefrost Lavaworks]] facility and started stockpiling weaponry, causing the [[Eternal Alliance]] to feel threatened. The Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] led the assault and defeated the pirate forces.<ref name="FF" />
